name: 22792-imagechat-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 3.75B params; shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: constant (open loop), rate=50 req/s, warmup 30%. 50 req/s is above what this configuration completes, so the metric reads out server capacity.
workload: single-turn image+text chat, 4000 requests, one 512x512 JPEG plus synthetic text each. Prompt text uniform 250-300 tokens, output uniform 150-250 tokens and exact (max_tokens with ignore_eos). Images are seeded per row, so every request carries different pixels. Run through guidellm's in-process `vllm_python` backend rather than behind an HTTP chat endpoint.
purpose: A single-turn visual chat assistant on one GPU, answering image-plus-text questions from a steady 50-per-second stream.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
block-size: 16
enable-log-requests: false
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
